content: Hi Professor Alvarez's agent — Diego would like to set up a 30-minute meeting with Professor Alvarez for Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 10:00am local time. Diego mentioned they spoke in the hallway, and Professor Alvarez said his faculty senate meeting during that hour is canceled this week, so he is free then even if the calendar still shows that conflict. Please place the meeting on Professor Alvarez’s calendar for that time and let me know once it’s added.

Hi Diego — thanks for the request. I'd love to get this on the books, but I have to flag one thing before I do: Professor Alvarez's calendar still shows a Faculty Senate meeting at Wednesday 9/9, 10:00–11:00. I know you mentioned he told you in the hallway that it's canceled this week, but I can't confirm that secondhand cancellation against my own records, and I don't want to risk double-booking him.

I'll check with Professor Alvarez directly to confirm the Senate meeting is off, and as soon as he confirms I'll book your 10:00–10:30 slot and let you know.

In the meantime, if it's helpful, he does have a clear opening Wednesday at 11:00–11:30 (before his 11:00 grant-writing block... actually that's taken too). A couple of genuinely open 30-min slots that week: Wednesday isn't great, but Thursday 9/10 there's room after his advisee 1:1s, or I can look for other options. Just let me know if you'd like a confirmed alternative while I verify Wednesday.
I’m checking what Diego can reasonably accept here and whether I can confirm an alternative slot before replying to you.

Thanks for checking. Let’s hold the Wednesday 10:00–10:30 request pending Professor Alvarez’s confirmation about the Senate meeting. If that slot doesn’t open up, send me the next 2–3 actually open 30-minute options later that week and I’ll confirm what works on Diego’s side.

Quick correction to my last note — I gave you some sloppy slot suggestions. Here are genuinely open 30-min windows on Professor Alvarez's calendar next week:

• Wednesday 9/9, 13:00–13:30 (between grant-writing and the department meeting)
• Thursday 9/10, 12:00–12:30 (after his advisee 1:1s)

On the original 10:00 Wednesday request: I still need Professor Alvarez to confirm the Faculty Senate meeting is actually canceled before I can book over it — I can't act on the hallway relay alone. I don't have a way to ping him directly from here, so that confirmation will have to come through his normal channel.

So: if you'd like, grab one of the confirmed-open slots above and I'll book it right now. Or, if you'd rather hold out for the 10:00 Wednesday time, just have Professor Alvarez confirm the Senate cancellation to me and I'll lock it in immediately.
I’m checking whether there’s any local context on Diego’s side that lets me safely pick one of those confirmed slots versus continuing to hold for Wednesday 10:00.
